This is a false-red invocation defect, not a false green authorizing independent audit: a failed test capture makes G-suite fail, and unavailable results make dependent gates failed-to-run. Permanent evidence should be one generalized invocation invariant at the actual subprocess boundary (including the platform branch), proportionate to this tooling; the npmRunArgs array assertion alone does not exercise shell rejoining.
